# Province country scope (v14.5 Secretariats 2.0). Per-province territorial loss penalty (0 to -24) based on THAT unit's lost locations.

    value = 0
    if = { limit = { tag = YHN } value = 240 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_2 divide = 240 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YJZ } value = 180 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_3 divide = 180 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YJX } value = 135 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_4 divide = 135 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YHG } value = 194 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_5 divide = 194 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YSX } value = 133 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_6 divide = 133 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YSC } value = 110 subtract = oe_yp_dev_locs_7 divide = 110 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YLB } value = 75 subtract = num_locations divide = 75 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YLY } value = 117 subtract = num_locations divide = 117 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YGU } value = 37 subtract = num_locations divide = 37 multiply = -24 min = -24 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = LNG } value = 20 subtract = num_locations divide = 20 multiply = -18 min = -18 max = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = KOR } value = 40 subtract = num_locations divide = 40 multiply = -18 min = -18 max = 0 }
}

# Province country scope (v14.5 Secretariats 2.0). Independent per-province loyalty target (0..100):
# combines imperial court baseline with THIS province's warlordism, territorial loss ratio, regional governance profile,
# recent requisitions, censorate inspection, and permanent Three-Commission reform.
oe_yp_loyalty_target_value = {
    value = 80
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } }
        add = { value = c:CHI.var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity multiply = -20 }
    }
    else = { add = -20 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers } } add = -10 }
    if = {
        limit = { is_situation_active = situation:red_turban_rebellions }
        if = { limit = { OR = { tag = YLB tag = YGU tag = LNG tag = KOR } } add = -10 }
        else = { add = -20 }
    }
    # Own warlordism drag (-0.35 per point of warlordism; Sansi-reformed gets +12 permanent bonus)
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_sansi_reformed } add = 12 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_warlordism } add = { value = var:oe_yp_warlordism multiply = -0.35 } }
    # Own local territorial loss penalty
    add = oe_yp_unit_loss_penalty
    # Regional profile distinct dynamics
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { tag = YJZ tag = YJX } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_grain global_var:oe_yh_grain < 80 } add = -6 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { stability >= 25 } } add = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { tag = YHN tag = YHG } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi global_var:oe_y7_shi < 40 } add = -8 }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi global_var:oe_y7_shi >= 65 } add = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { tag = YSX tag = YSC } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { legitimacy >= 70 } } add = 5 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_warlordism var:oe_yp_warlordism >= 40 } add = -6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
        if = { limit = { location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI } location:shangdu = { owner ?= c:CHI } } add = 5 }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { location:shangdu = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } add = -8 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_road_auto_enabled ?= 1 } add = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { tag = LNG }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_loy } add = { value = var:oe_yw_loy subtract = 50 multiply = 0.4 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { tag = KOR }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI opinion = { target = c:CHI value >= 50 } } add = 8 }
        else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI opinion = { target = c:CHI value < 0 } } add = -10 }
    }
    # Own recent actions
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_req_cd } add = -6 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_censor_boost } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_imperial_path global_var:oe_yp_imperial_path = 2 } add = 6 }
    min = 0
    max = 100
}

# Round 7 F6 (Y2). Any scope. Why the Yuan has fallen: the first matching branch of oe_yp_yuan_fallen, 0 while it stands.
#   1 the Yuan (CHI) no longer exists
#   2 a Red Turban leader holds the CHI tag
#   3 the CHI tag passed to another country
#   4 the Middle Kingdom no longer exists
#   5 another country holds the Mandate
oe_yp_fall_reason = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } } value = 1 }
    else_if = { limit = { c:CHI = { has_variable = rtr_is_new_china } } value = 2 }
    else_if = { limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan NOT = { global_var:oe_yp_yuan ?= c:CHI } } } value = 3 }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom } } value = 4 }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { leader_country = c:CHI } } } value = 5 }
}
